9.text: The function p shown gives the number of blank sheets of paper, p(x), remaining in a printer x days after the printer had been loaded with paper. Which statement is the best interpretation of p(5) = 105?

choices.A: The number of blank sheets of paper remaining in the printer decreased by a total of 5 sheets after 105 days.
choices.B: There were 5 blank sheets of paper remaining in the printer 105 days after the printer had been loaded with paper.
choices.C: There were 105 blank sheets of paper remaining in the printer 5 days after the printer had been loaded with paper.
choices.D: The number of blank sheets of paper remaining in the printer decreased by a total of 105 sheets after 5 days.

16.text: The estimated fuel cost C(x), in dollars, to drive a vehicle 100 kilometers is given by the function C(x) = 0.0019x² − 0.248x + 12.62, where x is the average speed, in kilometers per hour, of the vehicle. If the function C is graphed in the xy-plane, where y = C(x), what is the best interpretation of the point (60, 4.58) on the graph?

choices.A: The estimated fuel cost to drive the vehicle at an average speed of 4.58 kilometers per hour increases by $60 each hour.
choices.B: The estimated fuel cost to drive the vehicle at an average speed of 60 kilometers per hour increases by $4.58 each hour.
choices.C: The estimated fuel cost to drive the vehicle 100 kilometers at an average speed of 4.58 kilometers per hour is $60.
choices.D: The estimated fuel cost to drive the vehicle 100 kilometers at an average speed of 60 kilometers per hour is $4.58.
